systemicObservation: This is the first candidate in twelve to reach zero blockers and zero SHOULD-FIX. Two things distinguish it. First, every repair was verified by the check that caught the previous cycle's defect rather than by reading the ledger's own account of itself: for each id named in honestyRepairs, the frozen verdict was opened, its cited locations read, and those specific paths confirmed to have moved - and in MCICV10-A3's case, confirmed that the two paths its fix said to preserve were preserved. That check now passes cleanly. Second, the repairs were made where the findings pointed rather than beside them: rolelessNaQualification and componentLane.rolelessNa were both edited, the conflated ledger entry was split into two entries that name each other's boundary, and the Windows deferral was added to the property set rather than substituted into it - the failure mode that produced CLAUDE-V10-S1. The substantive contract has been byte-identical for two cycles, which is what a converged design looks like: the last three cycles moved only provenance recording. The one remaining advisory is orthographic and has consumed a slot in six of the last seven cycles; retiring it in one pass would leave the artifact with no open reviewer items from this lane.

verdictStatement: v12 clears both thresholds. The finding this reviewer raised at v11 - a repair ledger in which a real fix stood surety for an untouched one - is closed at both halves: the entries are split, each names the other's boundary explicitly, and the id-to-locations check confirms that both clauses Codex's MCICV10-A3 cited actually moved while the two its fix said to preserve were preserved. ROLELESS-NA is now language-gate N/A scoped to componentLane.must[7], with DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN reserved for DEF-WIN, must[0..6] and signed-closure evidence explicitly retained, and the three DR-118/DR-119/DR-120 rides kept distinct. The LIVE block re-measures at the adopted head with both digests matching the dispatch's own declared pins, and now re-verifies all five D-002 named properties including the Windows deferral - each independently confirmed by this reviewer at the live bytes, the last of which wraps across a line break and is easily missed. The demotion note carries its status label once. The roster is closed at zero off-roster paths and the substantive contract - selector, ownership record, G16 classes - is byte-identical for the second consecutive cycle. One advisory remains, orthographic, correctly scoped by the artifact's own claim, and not a bar to acceptance. ACCEPT is a reviewer opinion on this candidate only: it does not mark DR-121 SATISFIED, does not QUALIFY DR-G16, and does not authorize anything. Those acts belong to the coordinator, and DR-121 remains OPEN and DR-G16 remains PROPOSED on the live register as this verdict is written.

It edits no subject, marks DR-121 nothing, marks no gate QUALIFIED, authorizes no implementation, chooses no CI vendor, mints no D-096 (A) grant, and does not touch docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md or docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md.
